examples.input:
from datetime import date
birthdays = BirthdayDict()
birthdays["Ada"] = date(1815, 12, 10)
birthdays["Bob"] = date(1990, 12, 10)
examples.output: Hey Bob, there are more people with your birthday!
examples.explanation: Only month and day determine a shared birthday.

test_birthday_dict.title: test_birthday_dict
test_birthday_dict.code:
def test_birthday_dict(capsys):
    bd = BirthdayDict()
    bd['bob'] = date(1987, 6, 15)
    bd['tim'] = date(1984, 7, 15)
    assert capsys.readouterr().out == ''
    bd['mary'] = date(1987, 6, 15)  # whole date match
    assert capsys.readouterr().out.strip() == MSG.format('mary')
    bd['sara'] = date(1987, 6, 14)
    assert capsys.readouterr().out == ''
    bd['mike'] = date(1981, 7, 15)  # day + month match
    assert capsys.readouterr().out.strip() == MSG.format('mike')

test_values_are_stored.title: test_values_are_stored
test_values_are_stored.code:
def test_values_are_stored():
    bd = BirthdayDict()
    bd['bob'] = date(1987, 6, 15)
    bd['mary'] = date(1990, 6, 15)
    assert bd['bob'] == date(1987, 6, 15)
    assert bd['mary'] == date(1990, 6, 15)
    assert len(bd) == 2
    assert dict(bd) == {'bob': date(1987, 6, 15), 'mary': date(1990, 6, 15)}

test_same_year_and_month_is_not_a_match.title: test_same_year_and_month_is_not_a_match
test_same_year_and_month_is_not_a_match.code:
def test_same_year_and_month_is_not_a_match(capsys):
    bd = BirthdayDict()
    bd['ann'] = date(2000, 1, 1)
    bd['ben'] = date(2000, 1, 2)
    bd['cid'] = date(2000, 2, 1)
    assert capsys.readouterr().out == ''

test_message_once_per_new_person.title: test_message_once_per_new_person
test_message_once_per_new_person.code:
def test_message_once_per_new_person(capsys):
    bd = BirthdayDict()
    bd['a'] = date(1970, 12, 24)
    bd['b'] = date(1980, 12, 24)
    bd['c'] = date(1990, 12, 24)
    lines = capsys.readouterr().out.strip().splitlines()
    assert lines == [MSG.format('b'), MSG.format('c')]

test_update_and_constructor_use_setitem.title: test_update_and_constructor_use_setitem
test_update_and_constructor_use_setitem.code:
def test_update_and_constructor_use_setitem(capsys):
    bd = BirthdayDict({'x': date(1999, 3, 3)})
    bd.update({'y': date(2001, 3, 3)})
    assert capsys.readouterr().out.strip() == MSG.format('y')
    assert bd['y'] == date(2001, 3, 3)

test_leap_day_and_exact_single_newline.title: test_leap_day_and_exact_single_newline
test_leap_day_and_exact_single_newline.code:
def test_leap_day_and_exact_single_newline(capsys):
    bd = BirthdayDict()
    bd['first'] = date(2000, 2, 29)
    assert capsys.readouterr().out == ''
    bd['second'] = date(2004, 2, 29)
    assert capsys.readouterr().out == MSG.format('second') + '\n'
    bd['third'] = date(2008, 2, 29)
    assert capsys.readouterr().out == MSG.format('third') + '\n'
    assert len(bd) == 3

test_constructor_detects_matches_within_.title: test_constructor_detects_matches_within_its_input
test_constructor_detects_matches_within_.code:
def test_constructor_detects_matches_within_its_input(capsys):
    bd = BirthdayDict({'a': date(1970, 12, 31), 'b': date(2000, 12, 31)})
    assert capsys.readouterr().out == MSG.format('b') + '\n'
    assert bd['a'] == date(1970, 12, 31)
    assert bd['b'] == date(2000, 12, 31)

test_instances_do_not_share_birthdays.title: test_instances_do_not_share_birthdays
test_instances_do_not_share_birthdays.code:
def test_instances_do_not_share_birthdays(capsys):
    one, two = BirthdayDict(), BirthdayDict()
    one['a'] = date(1990, 1, 1)
    two['b'] = date(2000, 1, 1)
    assert capsys.readouterr().out == ''
    assert list(one) == ['a']
    assert list(two) == ['b']

test_empty_constructor_and_nonmatching_u.title: test_empty_constructor_and_nonmatching_update
test_empty_constructor_and_nonmatching_u.code:
def test_empty_constructor_and_nonmatching_update(capsys):
    bd = BirthdayDict({})
    assert len(bd) == 0
    bd.update({'a': date(2001, 1, 1), 'b': date(2001, 1, 2)})
    assert capsys.readouterr().out == ''
    assert len(bd) == 2
